title: Lena and the Wreck
author: Quentin Zhou
blurb: Hazel Kavanagh, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
